description: Implementation of Metal graphics state cache and pipeline management for ANGLE project, including classes and functions for creating, caching, and managing Metal descriptors, pipeline states, and related graphics states.

classes.name: StateCache
classes.description: Caches Metal depth-stencil and sampler states for efficient reuse.

classes.name: RenderPipelineCache
classes.description: Manages creation and caching of Metal render pipeline states.

classes.name: DepthStencilDesc
classes.description: Describes depth-stencil state parameters for Metal.

classes.name: SamplerDesc
classes.description: Describes sampler state parameters for Metal.

classes.name: BlendDesc
classes.description: Describes blending state parameters for Metal.

classes.name: RenderPipelineColorAttachmentDesc
classes.description: Describes color attachment state for render pipeline.

classes.name: RenderPipelineOutputDesc
classes.description: Describes output configuration of a render pipeline.

classes.name: RenderPipelineDesc
classes.description: Describes the configuration of a render pipeline.

classes.name: RenderPassAttachmentDesc
classes.description: Describes attachment parameters for a render pass.

methods.name: getNullDepthStencilState
methods.description: Returns a cached null depth-stencil state object.

methods.name: getDepthStencilState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a depth-stencil state based on description.

methods.name: getSamplerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sampler state based on description.

methods.name: getNullSamplerState
methods.description: Returns a cached null sampler state object.
